defects: Uses global Antitone f instead of AntitoneOn f (Ici N) restricted to a ray, dropping the ray parameter N
Uses global nonneg (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) instead of nonneg only on Ioi N, an unwarranted strengthening
Summable (f ∘ Int.cast) sums over all of ℤ (including negative integers), not over ℕ shifted by N as in gold's Summable (fun n ↦ f (n+N)); this is a materially different and stronger condition

Combining global Antitone, global nonnegativity, and two-sided ℤ-summability forces f to be identically 0 (a non-decreasing nonneg sequence tending to 0 as index → -∞ must vanish, and antitone+nonneg then forces f ≡ 0 everywhere), making the produced theorem vacuous/trivial rather than expressing the intended integral-test-converse content
No parameter N ties hypotheses to conclusion; conclusion instead existentially quantifies an unrelated a : ℝ, disconnected from the ray used in the hypotheses
Conclusion phrased as ∃ a, Integrable (indicator (Ici a) f) rather than IntegrableOn f (Ioi N) for the specific N from the hypotheses, changing the logical structure of the statement
